clinician.final_diagnosis: Disseminated paracoccidioidomycosis in a liver transplant patient
clinician.trajectory_summary: A liver transplant recipient presented with disseminated skin lesions and pulmonary involvement. Clinical examination revealed acneiform lesions and erythematous papules with ulcerated centers disseminated on the face (E001). Imaging with CT scan demonstrated peribronchial and perivascular parenchymal consolidations consistent with pulmonary involvement (E004). The combination of characteristic mucocutaneous lesions (facial papules with ulceration) and pulmonary infiltrates in an immunocompromised transplant recipient is consistent with disseminated paracoccidioidomycosis. The clinical presentation pattern—with facial skin involvement and pulmonary consolidations—aligns with the known disseminated form of paracoccidioidomycosis that occurs in immunosuppressed hosts.
